Defense: an endpoint atlas. Each identity registers one hardware endpoint; the entry crystallizes on write, like a crystal lattice, never editable, splittable, or re-registerable. Weight rides on that single atlas entry.

New endpoints get velvet-rope treatment: trial tasks only until the entry ages in, while peers sample-verify one endpoint per identity. Duplicates fail fingerprints.

A sybil farm needs N real endpoints, each paying its own deposit and trial window. No cloning; cost grows linearly with N; honest agents register once.
